answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 44315 Country: India Title: Can we sit and sleep in our house by stretching our legs towards the direction of Qiblah Question: Can we sit and sleep in our house by stretching our legs towards the direction of Qiblah? Answer ID: 44315 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 513/L=218/TL=1434) It is makrooh to sit or sleep at home while stretching the legs towards Qiblah. يكره مدالرجلين إلى القبلة فى النوم وغيره عمداً (شامى، 1/554) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
